mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ds_agent_event (id, tenant_id, run_id, sequence, frame_text, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{runId}, #{sequence}, #{frameText}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence), 0) FROM ds_agent_event WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND run_id = #{runId}
SELECT id, tenant_id, run_id, sequence, frame_text, created_at FROM ds_agent_event WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND run_id = #{runId} AND sequence > #{sequence} ORDER BY sequence ASC
